description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/wedding_setlist_readiness.xlsx. The spreadsheet tracks your band's readiness for an upcoming wedding gig. It has 8 songs with readiness ratings (0-100%) for each band member (Guitar, Bass, Drums, Vocals). Your task: In column F (Band Avg %), create AVERAGE formulas to calculate the average readiness across all four members for each song (rows 2-9). In column H (Gap to Target), create formulas to calculate the difference between the Target (column G, which is 100%) and the Band Avg. In column I (Priority), assign priority labels: 'HIGH PRIORITY' for songs with Band Avg < 50%, 'MEDIUM PRIORITY' for 50-79%, and 'LOW PRIORITY' for 80%+. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
